rendered: The paper doesn't give a separate patient count. What it says is that serum samples were collected from three enrolled subjects[1]. These subjects were septic patients with confirmed E. coli infection, septic patients with confirmed E. faecium infection, and healthy volunteers serving as the control[2]. That total includes the healthy control, so it seems there was a single patient for each infection. The paper doesn't state this outright. Each serum sample was measured more than once. The repeated data points in the LDA plot are technical replicates[3] and do not represent extra patients (see Fig. 5[4]).
